description: Polyphonic plucked string built on the Karplus-Strong algorithm, with control over damping, decay time, pluck angle, pluck position and pluck level

params.text: Plucks the string once on each press
Sets the frequency of the string, 30 semitones either side of 261.63Hz
Sets the damping of the string, 0 to 1, higher settings giving a duller tone and lower ones a brighter one
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the DMP input before it is added to the damping
Sets the angle of the pluck, smoothing the excitation more as it rises, and the value in use is held at 0.9 even where the knob reads 1
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the DIR input before it is added to the pluck angle
Sets the time the string takes to fall by 60dB, 0.1 to 10 seconds
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the DCY input before it is added to the decay time
Sets where along the string the pluck happens, 0 at the bridge and 1 at the middle of the string
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the POS input before it is added to the pluck position
Sets the strength of the pluck, 0 to 1, lower settings giving a softer and darker excitation
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the LVL input before it is added to the pluck level

inputs.text: A rising edge plucks the string, reading high above 2V and low below 0.1V
Sets the pitch of the string at a volt per octave, added to the FRQ knob, and the number of channels patched here is the number of strings that sound
A voltage added to the damping, scaled by the slider for DMP, with 10V covering the whole range at the slider's full setting
A voltage added to the pluck angle, scaled by the slider for DIR, with 10V covering the whole range at the slider's full setting
A voltage added to the decay time at one second per volt, scaled by the slider for DCY
A voltage added to the pluck position, scaled by the slider for POS, with 10V covering the whole range at the slider's full setting
A voltage added to the pluck level, scaled by the slider for LVL, with 10V covering the whole range at the slider's full setting
The signal used to excite the string, halved on the way in and summed to one channel if it is polyphonic; white noise excites the string when nothing is patched here

outputs.text: The string, with one channel per channel patched into FRQ

notes: the number of channels at the output is taken from the V/OCT input, so with nothing patched there the output carries no channels and the module is silent
